name: Google
summary: Calendar, inbox, tasks and files with independent Google sign-in and settings.
capabilities: Reads only the Google services you select
Optional selected-email read for Nero Flow and editable local reply drafts; no sending or Gmail draft writes
Keeps its own account in macOS Keychain
Contributes calendar events and dated tasks to the Nook agenda
Optional permission-scoped Calendar event list/verification for other plugins; existing read-only OAuth scope, no event edits
